Tyler: Quick sync — planning cutover for asia-south1 next Tue 10:00 UTC. Need routing policy + residency signoff. Eng-platform: @Marta @Lee, infra: @Nidhi, security: @Jen. Can we confirm owners and any blockers?
Marta: Eng-platform will own routing policy + rollout. I'll own the canary for ~2 hours. Added PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/432 — needs review.
Lee: Quick review notes on PR: two nits on healthcheck timeout and retry backoff. Also we need to lock edge capacity targets: aim for p95 <120ms at 2k rps during canary.
Nidhi: Infra side: we can provision extra nodes, but need an approved provisional quota increase. I can spin +3 g5 nodes in ap-south1. Will open infra ticket with numbers.
Sam: Finance: provisional bump approved for Q2 spend. Need exact estimate in the infra ticket to finalize billing flow. cc @Nidhi
Nidhi: Estimate in ticket: +3 g5 nodes -> approx $9k/month. Ticket #INF-981 opened with details and autoscale knobs.
Jen: Security/residency: did a data flow check — inference logs and traces are configured to stay in-region. Need a final KMS CMK check in ap-south1 before cutover. @Ada can you confirm?
Ada: Confirmed — customer CMK exists in ap-south1 and key policy allows Redwood service principal. Also adding fallback: if primary region CPU >80% for 3m, route new requests to eu-west1 and apply token-scrub header. I'll paste routing snippet in a sec.
Marta: Good. Please add fallback to the routing PR. For clarity, fallback conditions: CPU>80% for 3m OR avg queue latency >200ms.
Ada: Routing policy snippet (will include in PR):
```
{"policy": "primary-first",
 "primary": "ap-south1",
 "fallback": "eu-west1",
 "conditions": {"cpu_pct": 80, "window_mins": 3, "queue_ms": 200},
 "transform": "token-scrub"
}
```
Ops-bot: Deploy pipeline triggered for routing-pr-432 — build #2024. Estimated deploy ETA ~18m.
Sam: Who owns rollback if we see a latency spike during canary — Eng-oncall or Eng-platform?
Lee: Eng-oncall should perform immediate rollback if SLOs break. Eng-platform owns the policy and post-mortem / fix. We'll coordinate on-call runbook steps.
Tyler: Action items summary: Marta — add fallback & smoke test steps to PR/runbook; Nidhi — infra ticket + provision nodes; Jen — KMS final check; Lee — healthcheck timeout + oncall coordination; Sam — finance follow-up. I'll schedule the canary window and post runbook link. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Marta: Acknowledged. I'll tag owners in PR and update runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/asia-south1-cutover
Ada: Added token-scrub shim and fallback rule to PR branch.
Tyler: Okay let's reconvene async if anything blocks. Otherwise cutover on Tue 10:00 UTC.
Sam: Ack.
ops-bot: Status update: routing-pr-432 build #2024 passed basic checks — smoke tests queued.
